summary: TEN Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the termination of three material agreements: the RyuShin Advisors LLC Follow-On Offering Advisory Agreement (terminated immediately), the PeakValue, LLC Master Services Agreement (terminated immediately), and the Cherish Gloss Group Limited Capital Market Services Agreement (termination effective upon 90 days' written notice, or October 18, 2026). All terminations occurred on July 20, 2026, and were motivated by the company's strategic shift deeming these agreements no longer necessary. No financial terms, fees, or penalties were disclosed. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or any other classic special situation; it is a routine termination of service contracts. What to watch: any operational impacts from the loss of advisory and service support; no risk-arb angle.
